pages.text:
No iron needed.
- Copper Gear: 4 copper ingots around a cobblestone.
- Winding Crank and Mainspring.
Put the spring in the crank, then hold right-click on the crank. Full in about 2 minutes.
pages.title: 1. Copper day

pages.text:
Craft Stumpy (trees) or Sprout (crops).
- Place it with a chest or Supply Crate touching it.
- Right-click it with the wound Mainspring.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area.
pages.title: 2. First robot

pages.text:
- Tinker's Hammer: 2 ingots in the grid = 1 plate.
- Combustion Generator: coal or logs, 80 FE/t.
- Charger next to it: right-click it with a cell or tool.
- Copper Cell: your first battery.
pages.title: 3. First iron

pages.text:
Smithing table, Tool Upgrade Kit I + Electric Motor:
- hammer: Bore Drill
- Felling Axe: Chainsaw
V switches 1x1 / 3x3. A Copper Cell in your inventory recharges the drill.
pages.title: 4. Power tools

pages.text:
Diamonds open Age 2.
- Excavator: digs a hole to bedrock. Speed cards and power make it fast.
- Advanced Circuit, Reinforced Casing: the Servo parts.
pages.title: 5. Diamonds

pages.text:
- Click an item: its recipe. Click ingredients to go down the ladder.
- Next steps (first chapter): what to do now.
- Guide steps unlock the next recipes in your recipe book.
- Shift on an item: details and keys.
- L: Robotica advancements.
pages.title: Where to look

pages.text:
0 Clockwork: copper, wood
1 Wired: iron, redstone, gold
2 Servo: diamond, obsidian
3 Deep: netherite, blaze
4 Antigrav: pearls, nether star

Servo Core: Scrap Colossus. Magma Core: Forge Tyrant. Antigrav Core: crafted (nether star).
pages.title: Five ages

pages.text:
Each age has a casing, a circuit and a motor part, made from parts of the age before.
A Reinforced Casing takes 4 Iron Casings.
pages.title: The parts ladder

pages.text:
- Plates: hammer (2 ingots) or Metal Press (1 ingot). Other mods' plates work too.
- Circuits: gold (Basic), diamond (Advanced), blaze rods + netherite (Quantum), nether star (Null).
pages.title: Plates and circuits

pages.text:
Robotica runs on FE: other mods' generators and cables work.
- Winding Crank: by hand, Mainsprings only.
- Combustion Generator: 80 FE/t. Speed cards: more FE/t; efficiency: -10% fuel each.
- Solar Panel Mk1-4: 20 / 80 / 200 / 320 FE/t by day.
pages.title: Making FE

pages.text:
- Mainspring: 240k FE
- Copper Cell: 800k
- Redstone Cell: 3.2M
- Ender Cell: 20.7M
Right-click a robot to swap one in. A cell in your inventory recharges the tool in your hand.
pages.title: Batteries

pages.text:
- Accumulator I, II, III: 1M, 4M, 16M FE. Output on the front; keeps its charge when broken.
- Charger: right-click it with a cell or tool.
pages.title: Storing FE

pages.text:
Charges your FE items within 8 blocks, 1,000 FE/t each: armor first, then hands, then inventory.
- Owner and team only.
- Range and speed cards.
pages.title: Wireless Charger

pages.text:
Wireless FE. Put a coil on a generator or Accumulator.
- Tesla Linker: sneak-right-click the coil, then right-click a machine.
- Coil to coil: further, -5% per hop.
- Tier I-V: 4-32 links, 8-32 blocks, 4k-1M FE/t.
pages.title: Tesla Coils

pages.text: 1 ingot = 1 plate (the hammer needs 2). Right-click it with ingots or feed it by hopper or pipe.
pages.title: Metal Press

pages.text:
- Thorium: Overworld, Y -48 to 32.
- Pyrolite: Nether, most in basalt deltas.
- Resonite: outer End islands, rare, diamond pickaxe.
The hammer cracks them into dust; the Grinder doubles.
pages.title: New ores

pages.text:
The only source of alloys.
- Ferrothorium: iron + thorium
- Pyrosteel: ferrothorium + pyrolite + blaze powder
- Resonant: pyrosteel + resonite + ender pearl
pages.title: Alloy Smelter

pages.text:
Up to 6 inputs, 1 part.
- Only source of Thermocouples, Superconductor Coils, Resonant Lattices.
- Circuits, motors, casings: about a quarter cheaper than crafting.
pages.title: Assembler

pages.text:
1 input, up to 4 outputs, some by chance.
Depleted Fuel Pellet: thorium dust back, 10% a Radiant Isotope.
pages.title: Centrifuge

pages.text:
- Speed x1, x2, x3, x5.
- Card slots 2 to 5 (the Mk rule).
Right-click a placed machine with the next Mk: it swaps in, keeps everything, and gives the old one back.
pages.title: Mk1 to Mk4

pages.text:
Assembler: thorium dust + graphite + ferrothorium plate = Thorium Fuel Pellet.
RTG: 150 FE/t for 20 minutes per pellet, silent. Reactors burn pellets faster and hotter.
pages.title: Fuel and the RTG

pages.text:
Hollow boxes:
- casing on every edge
- walls: casing, glass, ports
- controller in a side wall, screen out
The controller names the wrong block. Its spyglass button outlines it.
pages.title: Multiblocks

pages.text:
3x3x3 to 9x9x9. Inside: Capacitors and 1+ Transfer Coil.
- Capacitors: 8M, 64M, 512M, 4G FE
- Coils: 64k, 512k, 4M FE/t
Sneak-right-click a port: in or out.
pages.title: Capacitor Bank

pages.text:
5x5x5 to 7x7x7.
- Fuel Rods: full columns.
- Coolant beside rods: water 1, ice 1.5, packed 2, blue 3, Cryo 4.
- Pellets: controller or Access Port.
- FE out: Power Port.
5x5x5, 1 rod column: about 1,150 FE/t.
pages.title: Fission Reactor

pages.text:
- Over 1,000 C: less output.
- 1,800 C: SCRAM, it shuts down.
Fix the cooling, let it cool below 200 C, press Reset. The slider pushes rods in for less heat.
pages.title: Heat and SCRAM

pages.text:
7x3x7 of Fusion Casing; inside, 16 Fusion Coils ring an empty 3x3.
- Charge 20M FE through a Power Port.
- Add fusion fuel: about 200,000 FE/t.
It burns fuel even when nobody takes the power.
pages.title: Fusion Reactor

pages.text:
- Ore: 2 dusts. Raw ore: 1 dust, 25% one more.
- Every mod's ores work.
Smelt the dust anywhere. Cobblestone, bones, blaze rods and more grind too.
pages.title: Grinder

pages.text:
Optional second slot: more dust and a byproduct chance.
Flint +10%, Iron +25%, Ferrothorium +50%, Pyrosteel +100%, Resonant +150%.
The bar shows what is left. Better balls need a higher Mk.
pages.title: Grinding media

pages.text:
A furnace on FE, twice as fast. Lanes per Mk: 1, 2, 4, 8.
Take the output by hand for the experience.
pages.title: Electric Furnace

pages.text:
Right-click it with the next Mk (contents stay) or craft around it: x1, x1.5, x2, x3 speed.
- Grinder: Speed, Efficiency, Fortune, Void
- Furnace: Speed, Efficiency, Range, Fortune
pages.title: Mk tiers and cards

pages.text:
- Stumpy: fells trees, replants.
- Sprout: harvests, replants, tills.
Both fill a chest or Supply Crate they touch. A stalled robot smokes and says why.
pages.title: Stumpy and Sprout

pages.text:
Right-click a placed robot with a Farm Kit.
- Mk1: 9x9 (Stumpy 7x7)
- Mk2: 13x13, faster
- Mk3: 17x17
- Mk4: 25x25
Each Mk: one more card slot, higher caps.
pages.title: Farm tiers

pages.text:
Right-click a block to deploy, sneak-right-click to pick up.
- Add a battery and torches. Menu: direction, length, then the pickaxe button.
- Digs a lit 3x3 tunnel (Mk3: 5x5, Fortune I).
H: dig where you look. Sneak+H: all come back.
pages.title: Mining Drone

pages.text:
Shoots monsters only.
- Guard, Follow or Stay.
- Aggressive or Defensive.
Repair it with iron.
pages.title: Sentry Drone

pages.text:
Moves items between inventories.
- Sneak-click a source, then a target: one route (max 4).
- Filter in its menu.
- 1 stack per trip, Mk2 3.
pages.title: Courier Drone

pages.text:
Cards upgrade machines. Right-click one with a card.
- Speed: up to x20, more FE per action.
- Efficiency: -15% FE each.
- Range, Growth, Fortune stack.
- Silk, Void: one card.
pages.title: Upgrade cards

pages.text:
A machine with a Mk:
- Mk + 1 card slots
- Speed 2 per Mk
- Efficiency, Range, Growth 1 per Mk
- Fortune up to 3
Others have fixed slots.
pages.title: The Mk rule

pages.text:
- Height: taller Architect buildings.
- Carry: Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up.
pages.title: Other cards

pages.text:
Mines everything below it to bedrock: 8x8, 1 block every 3 s.
Seals fluids, skips chests and other block entities.
Mk2-4: right-click it with the next Mk.
pages.title: Excavator

pages.text:
- Speed: 8 cards (Mk4) = x20, 21x the FE per block.
- Range: +10 wide per card.
- Efficiency, Fortune or Silk, Void.
Each Mk: one more card slot, higher caps.
pages.title: Making it fast

pages.text:
Place it, power it: it turns FE into random ores, as if mined. No hole.
Any c:ores ore: coal, copper, iron often, diamonds rarely.
pages.title: Survey Rig

pages.text:
- 1 ore per 20 s at 200 FE/t.
- Mk2-4: faster, more slots, rare ores more often.
- 8 speed cards (Mk4): x20 speed, 21x the FE per ore.
- Magma Core: adds ancient debris and resonite.
pages.title: Survey rules

pages.text:
Modules upgrade what you carry: power tools, FE weapons and Exo armor. Cards upgrade machines.
- Tinker's Bench: put the item in, drop modules in.
- One of each kind per item.
- G (held) or J (worn armor) switches them.
pages.title: Modules

pages.text:
- Tools, weapons: Age 1-4 = 2-5 slots
- Exo pieces: Mk1-4 = 1-4 slots
- Higher levels need a higher Age or Mk.
- Level II and III: craft from the level below.
- No enchanting on FE gear.
pages.title: Slots and levels

pages.text:
- Hammer (Age 0): 3x3
- Bore Drill (1): 3x3
- Servo Drill (2): 5x5, vein
- Magma Drill (3): 9x9, smelt
- Null Drill (4): 12x12x12
FE tools have no durability.
pages.title: Mining tools

pages.text:
- V: next mode. Sneak+V: back.
- Hold sneak: 1 block.
- B: Fortune / Silk Touch / off.
- G: settings and modules.
pages.title: Controls

pages.text:
- Overclock I-III: +50/100/200% speed
- Fortune I-III, Silk Touch: B picks one
- Auto-Pickup, Void Filter
- Lamp Placer: lamps in the dark
- Power Regulator: less FE
Overclock, Fortune, Silk Touch and Looting need FE in the item.
pages.title: Tool modules

pages.text: Lamp Rod: right-click a block for a Spark Lamp (torch light, paid in FE). Sneak-right-click a lamp to remove it. The Lamp Placer module puts lamps where you mine in the dark.
pages.title: Lights

pages.text: Fell the whole tree and replant from your saplings. The Chainsaw also clears leaves. V: 1x1.
pages.title: Trees

pages.text: Smithing table: Upgrade Kit + old tool + a part or core. Energy, settings and modules carry over.
pages.title: Upgrading tools

pages.text:
- Gearblade (0): fast sword
- Shock Baton (1): slows
- Rivet Gun (2): no ammo
- Arc Blade (3): arcs to 3
- Null Lance (4): charged beam
Smithing: Gearblade > Baton > Arc Blade; Rivet Gun > Lance.
pages.title: Arsenal

pages.text:
- Sharpened Edge I-III: more damage
- Looting I-III
- Thermal Edge: sets on fire
- Armor Pierce: ignores 20-50% of armor
- Chain Lightning: Arc Blade
- Ricochet: Rivet Gun
- Lifesteal (Age 4): heals 10% of damage
pages.title: Weapon modules

pages.text:
Always drops a Servo Core.
- Only real attacks hurt it.
- Below half health: drones, and it overheats.
- Loot is locked to the killer for 2 minutes.
pages.title: Scrap Colossus

pages.text:
Rusted Foundry: copper ruins in plains, deserts, badlands. Its chest has a Signal Flare.
Right-click the altar with a flare. 5 minute cooldown.
pages.title: Summoning

pages.text:
- Arms up: slam. Jump, or get 5 blocks away.
- Arm back: thrown scrap. Keep moving.
- Furnace open: double damage. Hit it.
pages.title: The fight

pages.text:
Flares are cheap: copper, redstone, gunpowder, a motor.
Craft your own Colossus Altar (Age 2). The boss never breaks blocks.
pages.title: Farming it

pages.text:
Age 3, in the Nether. Always drops a Magma Core.
Cinder Forge: blackstone ruins in Nether caves. Its chest has an Ignition Charge.
Right-click the Forge Altar with it.
pages.title: Forge Tyrant

pages.text:
- Doors glow: flame breath. Step aside.
- Crucible back: magma globs. Keep moving.
- Hammer up: glowing rings. Get off them.
- Doors open: it vents. Double damage.
pages.title: Tyrant fight

pages.text:
Powered armor, no durability.
- Charge it in a Charger, or carry a cell.
- All 4 worn: they share energy.
- Empty: still armor, modules stop.
pages.title: The suit

pages.text:
J: module screen (or sneak-right-click a piece, or a Tinker's Bench). Drop modules in; the switch turns one off.
Each kind works once per suit.
pages.title: Modules

pages.text:
- Helmet: Night Vision, Auto-Feeder
- Legs: Servo Stride, Kinetic Generator
- Boots: Step Assist, Spring Heels, Fall Dampener, Magnet
- Any: Capacitor Plating
pages.title: Early modules

pages.text:
Smithing; keeps energy and modules.
- Mk2: Servo Actuator, 2 slots
- Mk3: Superconductor Coil, 3 slots
- Mk4: Resonant Lattice, 4 slots, fireproof
Each mark: 4x the battery.
pages.title: Marks

pages.text:
Levels I-III: craft from the level below + next age's circuits.
Higher levels do more and need a higher mark. Gold pips show the level.
pages.title: Levels

pages.text:
- Helmet: Solar Weave, Sonar (N), Rebreather, Robot HUD
- Chest: Jet Assist, Med Injector, Hazard Seal, Kinetic Shield
- Legs/boots: Dash (R)
- Boots: Hydro Fins
- Any: Power Regulator
pages.title: Servo and Deep

pages.text:
Mk3 chestplate. Crafted with an Antigrav Core.
K: on/off. 2,400 FE/s while flying.
pages.title: Flight

pages.text:
Mk2+ chestplate, all 4 pieces Mk2+. Never used up.
- Servo: O, Haste II + Speed
- Magma: fireproof, burning hits
- Antigrav: no fall damage, cheaper Flight
pages.title: Core socket

pages.text:
Day one. Feed it cobblestone, wood, glass, ingots or gems: they become matter.
Power: a wound Mainspring or any FE. Pick plots, press Build.
pages.title: Architect Table

pages.text:
Every plot: one 9x9 building. Neighbours join into a hall.
- Click a plot edge: door.
- Click a seam: inner wall.
- Shift-click: forget a plot.
pages.title: Buildings

pages.text:
- Clean Stone: from the start.
- Smooth Panel, Detailed Stone, Tech Stone: Iron, Reinforced or Null Casing in the casing slot.
Every block also has a normal recipe.
pages.title: Styles

pages.text:
Click Demolish twice: every built plot comes down, all inside.
- Its own building blocks: 75% matter back.
- The rest: into a chest touching the table.
pages.title: Demolish

pages.text: Right-click a monster with an Essence Vial. 8 samples of one mob fill it. No bosses.
pages.title: Capturing essence

pages.text:
3x3x3 of Frame, controller in a side, 1+ Glass, empty centre. Add a full vial and FE.
- Harvest: drops loot.
- Spawn: the real mob.
About 1 cycle a minute. Blaze, enderman, ghast and more: Magma Core. Shulker: Antigrav Core.
pages.title: The replicator

pages.text:
Name a pad, stand on it, right-click: go to your pads or public ones.
- 5,000 FE + 20 per block.
- Rift Upgrade: other dimensions, 100,000 FE.
pages.title: Warp Pads

pages.text:
- Recall Remote: sneak-right-click a pad to bind it. Hold right-click 3 s to go. Damage cancels.
- Rift Remote: stores 10 pads, any dimension. Right-click to pick one.
pages.title: Remotes

pages.text: Portal Projectors (Age 4): link two with a Linking Card, power them, walk through. Any dimension.
pages.title: Portals

pages.text:
A big sorted chest: 81 slots, search (@mod, #tag), 3x3 crafting grid.
Hoppers and pipes work on every side.
pages.title: Storage Terminal

pages.text:
- 3 expansion slots: +81, +162, +324 slots.
- 2 FE/t, +1 per expansion. Unpowered, nothing goes in; taking out works.
pages.title: Expansions and power

pages.text:
Pipes connect to pipes, chests and machines.
- Sneak-right-click an arm (empty hand): Insert, Extract or Off.
- Pipe: 8 items/s. Mk2: 32 per half second.
pages.title: Item pipes

pages.text:
Sides tab: click a face for Input, Output, both or None.
Auto-input pulls from Input faces, auto-eject pushes to Output faces.
pages.title: Machine sides

Put modules in the slots; switch them on or off.
Upgrade the mark at a smithing table: modules, energy and core are kept.
facts.what: Exo-Frame helmet: powered armor with module slots. No durability; modules run on its battery.

use: Press J to open the module screen (all worn pieces).
Put modules in the slots; switch them on or off.
Upgrade the mark at a smithing table: modules, energy and core are kept.
facts.what: Exo-Frame chestplate: powered armor with module slots. No durability; modules run on its battery.

facts.image: shots/14_exo_frames.jpg|Exo-Frame Mk1 to Mk4 on armor stands
use: Press J to open the module screen (all worn pieces).
Put modules in the slots; switch them on or off.
Upgrade the mark at a smithing table: modules, energy and core are kept.
facts.what: Exo-Frame leggings: powered armor with module slots. No durability; modules run on its battery.

facts.image: shots/14_exo_frames.jpg|Exo-Frame Mk1 to Mk4 on armor stands
use: Press J to open the module screen (all worn pieces).
Put modules in the slots; switch them on or off.
Upgrade the mark at a smithing table: modules, energy and core are kept.
facts.what: Exo-Frame boots: powered armor with module slots. No durability; modules run on its battery.
Exo module (helmet). Night vision. Levels II and III also show hostile mobs through walls (24 / 48 blocks).
Exo module (helmet). Breathe under water.
Exo module (helmet). Shows your nearby drones on the HUD: distance and health.
Exo module (helmet). Eats plain food from your inventory at food level 14 or less.
Exo module (helmet). Charges the suit by day under open sky.
Exo module (helmet). Key N: outlines ores and mobs around you for 10 s (16 / 24 / 32 blocks).
Exo module (chestplate). Slows long falls; 1 / 2 / 3 extra jumps in the air.
Exo module (chestplate). Creative flight. K toggles it.
Exo module (chestplate). Absorbs 75 / 85 / 95% of each hit with FE.
Exo module (chestplate). At 40% health heals 2 / 3 / 4 hearts; cooldown 60 / 45 / 30 s.
Exo module (chestplate). Clears poison, wither, hunger, nausea and blindness.
Exo module (leggings). +20 / 40 / 60% walking speed.
Exo module (leggings). Walking charges the suit.
Exo module (leggings or boots). Key R: a quick burst where you look; 3 s cooldown.
Exo module (boots). Walk up full blocks.
Exo module (boots). Jump higher: +0.15 / 0.25 / 0.35.
Exo module (boots). Absorbs fall damage beyond 3 blocks.
Exo module (boots). Pulls items within 6 / 10 / 16 blocks.
Exo module (boots). +50% swim speed and full mining speed under water.
Exo module (any piece). +50 / 100 / 200% battery for its piece. Works per piece.
Module for tools, weapons and Exo armor: less FE per block, per hit or for every module of the suit.

use: V switches 1x1 / 3x3.
Hold sneak to mine one block.
facts.what: Age 0 hammer: mines 1x1 or 3x3, and makes plates in the crafting grid (hammer + 2 ingots).

use: V switches whole tree / 1x1.
facts.what: Cuts a whole tree in one swing and replants from your saplings.
Fast copper sword.

use: V switches mode.
Keep a [[copper_cell]] in your inventory: it recharges the drill.
Add modules at a [[tinkers_bench]]: [[overclock_module]], [[fortune_module]], [[auto_pickup_module]]...
facts.what: First FE drill: iron pickaxe speed and tier, 1x1 or 3x3.

use: V switches whole tree / 1x1.
facts.what: Cuts whole trees, clears the leaves and replants.

facts.image: shots/24_spark_lamp_cave.jpg|Spark Lamps lighting a cave
use: Right-click a block face to place a lamp on the floor, a wall or the ceiling.
Sneak-right-click a lamp to remove it.
Charge it like any FE item.
facts.what: FE tool that places Spark Lamps: light 14, walk-through, break instantly.
Age 2 drill: adds 5x5 and vein mining (64).
Age 3 drill: adds 3x3x3 and 9x9, and auto-smelt.
Age 4 drill: up to 12x12x12 at full speed.
Hits and slows (Slowness II, 2 s).
Hold right-click: rapid fire, no ammo, runs on FE.
Lightning jumps from the target to 3 more monsters for 50% damage each.
Hold to charge 1 s, then a beam pierces every mob in a 32-block line.

facts.image: shots/gui_tinkers_bench.jpg|Tinker's Bench with a Null Drill and five modules
use: Put the tool, weapon or Exo piece in.
Drop modules in the slots: Age 1-4 opens 2-5, Mk1-4 opens 1-4.
Take a module out to get it back.
G (held tool or weapon) or J (worn armor) switches them.
facts.what: Fits modules into power tools, FE weapons and Exo armor pieces.

use: Smithing table: kit + old tool + the part or core.
facts.what: Smithing template for the next tool tier. Energy, mode and settings carry over.
Tool module: mines faster for more FE per block.
Drill module: mined blocks drop as with Fortune I / II / III. B switches Fortune, Silk Touch or off.
Drill module: mined blocks drop themselves. B switches Fortune, Silk Touch or off.
Tool module: drops go straight into your inventory.
Tool module: deletes cobblestone, dirt, gravel and other junk drops.
Weapon module: every paid hit or shot deals more damage.
Weapon module: kills drop as with Looting I / II / III.
Weapon module: paid hits and rivets set the target on fire for 4 s.

facts.image: shots/24_spark_lamp_cave.jpg|Spark Lamps lighting a cave
use: Install at a [[tinkers_bench]] in a drill.
facts.what: Drill module: places a Spark Lamp where you mine in the dark.
Weapon module: part of every paid hit ignores armor.
[[arc_blade]] module: more arcs that jump further.
[[rivet_gun]] module: a rivet that hits bounces on to the next monster in sight.
Age 4 weapon module ([[null_lance]]): heals you for part of the damage, paid in FE.

facts.image: shots/gui_bank_formed.jpg|Capacitor Bank Controller, formed
use: Build the bank around it, controller in a side wall.
Open it to see stored FE, in/out per second and problems.
facts.what: Brain of the Capacitor Bank: stores all its FE. Keeps the energy when mined.
Frame and wall block of the Capacitor Bank.
Wall block of the Capacitor Bank you can see through. Not on edges.
Moves FE in or out of a Capacitor Bank. Sneak-right-click to switch input/output.
Goes inside a Capacitor Bank. Each one adds storage.
Goes inside a Capacitor Bank. The coils together set how fast FE goes in and out.

facts.image: shots/gui_fission_formed.jpg|Fission Reactor Controller, formed
use: Build the reactor around it, controller in a side wall.
Put fuel pellets in.
Set the control rods with the slider to keep it under 1,000 C.
facts.what: Brain of the Fission Reactor: fuel, temperature and control rods.
Frame and wall block of the Fission Reactor. Also goes into Fusion Casing.
See-through wall block for both reactors. Not on edges.
Wall block that sends reactor FE out. On the Fusion Reactor it also takes the ignition charge in.
Wall block for fuel in and waste out. Hoppers and pipes work.
Goes inside a Fission Reactor in full columns, floor to roof.
The best reactor coolant: 4 points per side next to a fuel rod.

facts.image: shots/gui_fusion_formed.jpg|Fusion Reactor Controller, formed
use: Build the 7x3x7 around it.
Charge 20M FE through the Power Ports.
Add [[fusion_fuel_pellet]] and switch it on.
facts.what: Brain of the Fusion Reactor: ignition charge, plasma and fuel.
Frame and wall block of the Fusion Reactor.
Sixteen of these make the ring inside the Fusion Reactor.

facts.image: shots/16_grinder_furnace.jpg|Grinders and Electric Furnaces, Mk1 to Mk4
use: Put ores, raw ores or ingots in.
Add grinding media for a bonus.
Smelt the dusts in an [[electric_furnace_mk1]].
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade in place; everything inside stays.
facts.what: Doubles ores: 1 ore becomes 2 dusts. Works with every mod's ores by tag.

facts.image: shots/16_grinder_furnace.jpg|Grinders and Electric Furnaces, Mk1 to Mk4
use: Put items in the lanes.
Take results by hand to get the stored experience.
Right-click it with the next Mk to upgrade in place; everything inside stays.
facts.what: Smelts every furnace recipe in half the time, on several lanes at once.
Grinding media: more dust per ore and a chance of a byproduct. One loads into the Grinder and lasts its uses.
Ground ore. Smelt it into an ingot.

use: Place it among trees with a chest or [[supply_crate]] touching it.
Right-click it with a wound [[mainspring]] or a cell.
Sneak-right-click: status and work area.

guides.body:
Age 0 needs only wood, stone and copper. No iron.

{{image shots/codex_01_start.jpg|The Codex Next steps page}}

## Day one

1. **[[copper_gear]]**: 4 copper ingots + 1 cobblestone.
2. **[[winding_crank]]**: stick, 2 copper, a gear, 3 cobblestone.
3. **[[mainspring]]**: 8 copper around a gear. Holds 240,000 FE.
4. Put the Mainspring in the crank and **hold right-click** with an empty hand: 400 FE per turn, 5 turns/s. Full in about 2 minutes.
5. **[[clockwork_mechanism]]**: 4 gears, 4 planks, 1 cobblestone.
6. **[[wooden_chassis]]**: 4 logs, 4 cobblestone, 1 copper block.

{{items copper_gear winding_crank mainspring clockwork_mechanism wooden_chassis}}

## First robots

- [[stumpy]]: fells whole trees in a 7x7 area, replants, 250 FE per log.
- [[sprout]]: harvests and replants crops in a 9x9 area.
- Right-click the robot with the wound Mainspring (or a cell) to power it. Place a [[supply_crate]] (27 slots) next to the robot: it outputs there.
- Sneak-right-click with an empty hand: status and work area.

{{image shots/gui_stumpy.jpg|Stumpy's screen}}

## Plates by hand

- [[tinkers_hammer]] + 2 ingots in the grid = 1 plate (costs durability). Also mines 3x3.

## First iron hour

No gold or diamonds needed.

| [[combustion_generator]] | burns furnace fuel, 80 FE/t; right-click it with fuel |
| [[charger]] | charges FE items at 2,000 FE/t |
| [[copper_cell]] | 800,000 FE battery; recharges the tool in your hand |
| [[bore_drill]] | smithing: [[tool_upgrade_kit_1]] + Tinker's Hammer + [[electric_motor]]; 400k FE, 40 FE per block |

{{items combustion_generator charger copper_cell tool_upgrade_kit_1 bore_drill}}

## Tesla Coils

{{items tesla_coil_1 tesla_coil_2 tesla_coil_3 tesla_coil_4 tesla_coil_5 tesla_linker}}

| Tier | Links | Range | FE/t |
|---|---|---|---|

| [[tesla_coil_2]] | 8 | 12 | 16,000 |
| [[tesla_coil_3]] | 12 | 16 | 64,000 |
| [[tesla_coil_4]] | 16 | 24 | 256,000 |
| [[tesla_coil_5]] | 32 | 32 | 1,000,000 |

- A coil on a block that outputs FE (generator, Accumulator, panel) is a source. Any other coil is a relay.
- Each coil-to-coil hop loses 5%.

### Linking

1. Place a coil on the generator or battery.
2. Sneak-right-click the coil with the [[tesla_linker]].
3. Right-click a machine face (power enters there) or another coil.
4. Click the same face again to unlink. Sneak-right-click air clears the selection.

{{image shots/11_tesla_network.jpg|A Tesla Coil network}}

{{image shots/18_energy_multiblocks.jpg|Fission Reactor, Capacitor Bank and Fusion Reactor}}

## Charging your gear

- [[charger]]: one item at 2,000 FE/t. Right-click it with the item.
- [[wireless_charger]] (Age 2): everything you carry within 8 blocks, 1,000 FE/t per player. Worn armor first, then your hands, then the inventory. Only you and your team. Range cards +4 blocks, speed cards up to x6. Wireless costs 10% extra FE.

## Grinder

200 ticks at 20 FE/t on Mk1 (4,000 FE per ore).

| Input | Output |
|---|---|
| ore (`c:ores`) | 2 dust |
| gem ore | 2 gems |
| raw ore | 1 dust + 25% chance of one more |
| ingot | 1 dust |

- Ancient debris does not grind.
- Dusts smelt into ingots.

{{image shots/gui_grinder.jpg|Grinder Mk2 menu}}

## Electric Furnace

- Every vanilla smelting recipe at half the time, 20 FE/t per lane and item.
- Lanes in parallel: Mk1 1, Mk2 2, Mk3 4, Mk4 8.

## Grinding media

Optional second input. One item is loaded straight into the Grinder and lasts its uses (media bar); then the next one loads. Bonus only on ores and raw ores, never on gem ores or ingots.

| [[ferrothorium_grinding_balls]] | +50% | 10% | 32 | Mk2 |
| [[pyrosteel_grinding_balls]] | +100% | 20% | 64 | Mk3 |

A variable-size cuboid from 5x5x5 to 7x7x7 (outside size). Age 2-3 power.

## Parts

{{items reactor_controller reactor_casing reactor_glass reactor_power_port reactor_access_port reactor_fuel_rod cryo_coolant thorium_fuel_pellet enriched_fuel_pellet}}

## Steps

1. Build the **frame** (all 12 edges and 8 corners) from [[reactor_casing]]. No glass on edges.
2. Fill the **walls** with any mix of [[reactor_casing]], [[reactor_glass]], [[reactor_power_port]] (at least one) and [[reactor_access_port]] (optional).
3. Put the [[reactor_controller]] in a side wall, screen facing out.
4. Place [[reactor_fuel_rod]] blocks in **full columns**, floor to roof. A gap in a column breaks the structure.
5. Fill the rest of the inside with air or coolant. Only the 4 horizontal neighbours of a rod count.
6. Put fuel in: [[thorium_fuel_pellet]] or [[enriched_fuel_pellet]] into the controller or an Access Port. Take power from a Power Port (cable or a [[tesla_coil_1]] on top).

| Coolant | Points |
|---|---|
| [[minecraft:water]] | 1 |
| [[minecraft:ice]] | 1.5 |
| [[minecraft:packed_ice]] | 2 |
| [[minecraft:blue_ice]] | 3 |
| [[cryo_coolant]] | 4 |

| Fuel | Heat | Burn time | Waste |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[thorium_fuel_pellet]] | 400 | 12,000 ticks | [[depleted_fuel_pellet]] |
| [[enriched_fuel_pellet]] | 1,000 | 12,000 ticks | [[depleted_fuel_pellet]] |

> Access Ports take fuel in and hand waste out: hoppers and pipes work.

{{multiblock fission_reactor_5}}

{{multiblock fission_reactor_7}}

{{image shots/19_fission_reactor.jpg|A formed 5x5x5 Fission Reactor}}

{{image shots/gui_fission_formed.jpg|Fission Reactor Controller, formed}}

## Heat

- Up to **1,000 C**: full output.
- Above it the output throttles down to 25%; at **1,800 C** it SCRAMs. Reset from the GUI below 200 C.

Control rods (0-100%) are set with the GUI slider. Fuel only burns while the 5M FE buffer has room.

## Example outputs

| Build | Output |
|---|---|
| 5x5x5, one column of 3 thorium rods, 4 water around each | about 1,150 FE/t |
| Same with packed ice | about 1,350 FE/t |
| 7x7x7, 13 enriched columns in a Cryo Coolant checkerboard | about 45,000 FE/t at 32% load |

Water-only big reactors run hot: push some rods in.

| [[capacitor_resonant]] | 4,096,000,000 | 4 |

| Transfer Coil | Adds FE/t | Age |

| [[transfer_coil_elite]] | 4,000,000 | 3 |

The sum of all coils limits input and, separately, output per tick, shared by all ports.

{{image shots/20_capacitor_bank.jpg|A formed 5x5x5 Capacitor Bank}}

## Ports

- A [[bank_port]] is input or output: **sneak + right-click** toggles it (the face shows an arrow).
- Output ports push into the block outside them and can be pulled from; a [[tesla_coil_1]] on top works.

## Keeping the energy

- The energy lives in the controller: it stays when the structure breaks.
- Mined, the controller item keeps its energy (it always drops, explosions included).
- Formed smaller than its energy, the part above the new capacity is lost.

A fixed 7x3x7 structure (Age 4). It needs a 20M FE charge to start and burns fuel nonstop once lit.

## Parts

{{items fusion_controller fusion_casing fusion_coil reactor_glass reactor_power_port reactor_access_port fusion_fuel_pellet}}

## Build

1. Frame of [[fusion_casing]].
2. Walls of [[fusion_casing]], [[reactor_glass]], [[reactor_power_port]] (at least one) and [[reactor_access_port]] (fuel in only).
3. [[fusion_controller]] in a side wall.
4. Middle layer: a ring of **16** [[fusion_coil]] blocks around an empty 3x3 plasma chamber.

{{multiblock fusion_reactor}}

{{image shots/21_fusion_reactor.jpg|A formed Fusion Reactor}}

## Running it

1. **Charge**: Power Ports take FE in, at most **1,000,000 FE/t** in total, until the **20,000,000 FE** ignition charge is full. Use a Capacitor Bank or Tesla Coils.
2. **Fuel**: put [[fusion_fuel_pellet]] in the controller or an Access Port.
3. **Ignite**: switch it on; the charge is spent and the plasma lights.

| Fuel | Output | Burn time |
|---|---|---|
| [[fusion_fuel_pellet]] | 200,000 FE/t | 2,400 ticks |

- **Warmup**: output ramps from 0 to full over 10 s.
- **No throttle**: it burns fuel whether or not the power is taken (20M FE buffer).
- **Starve**: without fuel the plasma survives 5 s, then collapses and needs a new charge. Switching off or breaking the structure collapses it too.

{{image shots/gui_fusion_formed.jpg|Fusion Reactor Controller, formed}}

## 1. Take a sample

{{items essence_vial}}

- Right-click a hostile mob with an [[essence_vial]]: 2 damage, 3 s cooldown.
- The first sample binds the vial to that mob type.
- **8 samples** complete it.
- Bosses and blacklisted mobs can not be sampled.

## 2. Build the structure

{{items replicator_controller replicator_frame replicator_glass}}

- A 3x3x3 cube: [[replicator_controller]] in the middle of one face.
- The rest of the shell is [[replicator_frame]] and [[replicator_glass]] (at least 1 glass).
- The center block stays air.

{{multiblock mob_replicator}}

## 3. Run it

- Insert the complete vial and feed FE: **160 FE/t** base.
- One cycle takes **1,200 ticks** (1 min).
- Speed cards: max 3. A [[plasma_actuator]] in the boost slot doubles speed (not consumed, costs extra FE).
- Fortune cards act as **Looting** (up to III).

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| Harvest (default) | Rolls the mob's loot into an 18-slot output. No entity spawns. XP is stored and drops when you open the GUI. |
| Spawn | Spawns the real mob in front of the controller. Waits while 8 of that type (or 32 mobs) are within 8 blocks. |

{{image shots/gui_replicator_formed.jpg|Replicator Controller GUI, formed}}

Catalyst slot (kept):

| Mobs | Needs |
|---|---|
| Blaze, enderman, guardian, ghast, wither skeleton, piglin brute | [[magma_core]] |
| Shulker | [[antigrav_core]] |

- Boss drops

guides.body:
Each boss guards an age core. Both wake at an altar, drop their core every time, and lock their loot to the killer for 2 minutes.

## Rules for both

- Only hits from a living attacker hurt them. Traps, lava, fire and suffocation do nothing.
- A target they can't reach still gets hit from range.
- They never break blocks. Not on Peaceful.
- An altar cools down for 5 minutes after a summon and can't be mined while it cools.

## Scrap Colossus (Age 2)

{{items signal_flare colossus_altar servo_core}}

{{image shots/12_scrap_colossus.jpg|The Scrap Colossus on its altar}}

- Find a Rusted Foundry (plains, deserts, badlands) or craft a [[colossus_altar]].
- Right-click the altar with a [[signal_flare]].
- Arms up: ground slam. Jump or back off. Arm back: thrown scrap.
- Below half health it calls Scrap Drones and overheats: hit the open furnace for double damage.

## Forge Tyrant (Age 3)

{{items ignition_charge forge_altar magma_core}}

{{image shots/27_forge_tyrant.jpg|The Forge Tyrant venting next to its Forge Altar}}

- Find a Cinder Forge (blackstone ruins in Nether caves) or craft a [[forge_altar]].
- Right-click the altar with an [[ignition_charge]].

| Tell | Attack | Answer |
|---|---|---|
| Furnace doors glow | Flame breath, a 7 block cone | Step out of the cone |
| Crucible arm swings back | Magma globs | Keep moving |
| Hammer goes up | Glowing rings, then eruptions | Get off the rings |
| Doors swing open | Vent, after every 3 attacks | Hit it: double damage |

> Below half health it rings itself with eruptions and attacks faster. Fire Resistance helps against the burning.

## Core socket

Chestplate Mk2 and up holds one core. The bonus needs all four pieces worn, Mk2 or better.

| Core | Bonus |

| [[antigrav_core]] | no fall damage, Flight costs half, Dash cooldown halved |

{{image shots/22_wireless_charger.jpg|A Wireless Charger charging an Exo-Frame}}

## Keys and energy

- **J** module screen (or a [[tinkers_bench]]), **K** flight, **R** dash, **N** sonar, **O** overclock. Double jump is Jet Assist.
- With all four pieces on, modules share all four batteries. Cells in your inventory top the suit up (2,000 FE/s).

guides.body:
Pipes move items instantly between chests and machines.

{{items item_pipe item_pipe_mk2 grinder_mk1 electric_furnace_mk1}}

{{image shots/17_item_pipes.jpg|Item Pipes from a chest through a Grinder and an Electric Furnace into a chest}}

## Pipes

| Pipe | Moves |
|---|---|
| [[item_pipe]] | 8 items every second |
| [[item_pipe_mk2]] | 32 items every half second |

1. Lay pipes from the source to the target. Pipes of both tiers connect.
2. Every arm into a chest or machine starts as **Insert**.
3. Sneak-right-click the arm at the source with an empty hand: **Extract**. Again: **Off**.
4. Extract arms pull items and hand them to the Insert arms of the same line, in turn.

- A plain right-click shows an arm's mode.
- No filters. One network holds up to 4,096 pipes.

## Machine sides

Grinder, Electric Furnace, Alloy Smelter, Centrifuge, Assembler, RTG and Metal Press have a **Sides** tab right of their screen.

- Faces: Front, Back, Left, Right, Top, Bottom.
- Click a face: Input, Output, Input + Output or None. Right-click goes back.
- **Auto-input** pulls from chests on Input faces, **auto-eject** pushes results into chests on Output faces: up to 16 items every 10 ticks. Both start off.
- Pipes and hoppers follow the same rules. None means pipes do not connect.
- Default: every face both ways; Grinder and Electric Furnace bottom Output only.

Cards upgrade machines. Modules upgrade what you carry: power tools, FE weapons and Exo armor. FE gear takes no enchantments; the Age 0 tools (Tinker's Hammer, Felling Axe, Gearblade) still do.

{{items tinkers_bench overclock_module fortune_module sharpened_edge_module power_regulator_module}}

## Installing

1. Put the tool, weapon or Exo piece in a [[tinkers_bench]].
2. Drop modules in the open slots. Take one out to get it back.
3. G switches the modules of the tool or weapon in your hand, J those of your worn armor (J also installs).

- One of each kind per item. On Exo armor a kind works once per suit ([[capacitor_plating_module]] once per piece).
- Level II and III are crafted from the level below and need a higher Age or Mk.
- Every module starts switched on.

| Item | Slots |
|---|---|
| Power tools, FE weapons | Age 1 / 2 / 3 / 4: 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 |
| Exo pieces | Mk1 / 2 / 3 / 4: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 |

{{image shots/gui_tinkers_bench.jpg|Tinker's Bench with a Null Drill and five modules}}

## Tool modules

| Module | Fits | Min. Age | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[overclock_module]] I-III | drills, Chainsaw | 1 / 2 / 3 | +50 / 100 / 200% mining speed, +20 / 40 / 60% FE |
| [[fortune_module]] I-III | drills | 1 / 2 / 3 | Fortune I-III on drops |
| [[silk_touch_module]] | drills | 1 | blocks drop themselves |
| [[auto_pickup_module]] | drills, Chainsaw | 1 | drops go into your inventory |
| [[void_filter_module]] | drills, Chainsaw | 1 | deletes junk drops |
| [[lamp_placer_module]] | drills | 1 | Spark Lamps where you mine in the dark, 10 FE each |

> B cycles Fortune, Silk Touch and off. Overclock, Fortune and Silk Touch only work while the tool has FE.

## Weapon modules

| Module | Fits | Min. Age | Does |
|---|---|---|---|
| [[sharpened_edge_module]] I-III | FE weapons | 1 / 2 / 3 | +15 / 30 / 45% damage |
| [[looting_module]] I-III | FE weapons | 1 / 2 / 3 | Looting I-III on kills while the weapon has FE |
| [[thermal_edge_module]] | FE weapons | 1 | sets targets on fire |
| [[armor_pierce_module]] I-III | FE weapons | 1 / 2 / 3 | ignores 20 / 35 / 50% of armor |
| [[chain_lightning_module]] I-III | Arc Blade | 3 | more arcs, longer jumps |
| [[ricochet_module]] I-II | Rivet Gun | 2 | rivets bounce to 1 / 2 more monsters |
| [[lifesteal_module]] | FE weapons | 4 | heals 10% of damage dealt, from a 3-health pool |

## Everything

[[power_regulator_module]] I-III (Age or Mk 2 / 3 / 4) fits tools, weapons and Exo pieces: 15 / 25 / 35% less FE per block, per hit or for every module of the suit.

guides.body:
Cards upgrade machines. A machine takes only the kinds it can use.

{{items upgrade_speed upgrade_efficiency upgrade_range upgrade_fortune upgrade_silk upgrade_growth upgrade_void upgrade_height upgrade_carry}}

## Install

- Right-click the machine with the card, or put it in an upgrade slot.
- One kind per slot. Stackable kinds stack in that slot: every card is one step.

## The Mk rule

Every machine with a Mk (Alloy Smelter, Centrifuge, Assembler, Grinder, Electric Furnace, Excavator, Survey Rig, Stumpy and Sprout with Farm Kits):

{{mkrule}}

Machines without a Mk (Metal Press, Combustion Generator, Wireless Charger, Replicator, Architect Table, drones) have fixed slots, listed below.

## The cards

| Card | Max | One step |
|---|---|---|
| [[upgrade_speed]] | 8 | x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20 |
| [[upgrade_efficiency]] | 4 | -15% FE per action, never below 40% |
| [[upgrade_range]] | 4 | bigger area, depends on the machine |
| [[upgrade_fortune]] | 3 | Fortune I-III (Looting in the Replicator) |
| [[upgrade_silk]] | 1 | blocks drop themselves; not with Fortune |
| [[upgrade_growth]] | 4 | +50% crop and sapling growth |
| [[upgrade_void]] | 1 | deletes junk or outputs that don't fit |
| [[upgrade_height]] | 6 | Architect Table: buildings one block taller |
| [[upgrade_carry]] | 1 | Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up |

> Every speed card costs more FE per action than the one before: 1 card +30%, 8 cards x6.2. The quarries pay a steeper price: 8 cards cost 21x the FE per block in the [[excavator_mk4]].

## Which machine takes what

steps.text: Find a Cinder Forge (blackstone ruins in Nether caves) or craft an Ignition Charge.
steps.title: Into the Fire

steps.text: Use an Ignition Charge on a Forge Altar and beat the Forge Tyrant. Hit it when it vents.
steps.title: Quenched

steps.text: Get a Magma Core: Magma Drill, Arc Blade, Rift Upgrade, Age 3 mobs in the replicator.
steps.title: Hot Core

steps.text: Smith a Magma Drill. Turn on auto-smelt in its settings.
steps.title: Smelt as You Go

steps.text: Smith an Exo piece to Mk3 (Blazing Casing, Superconductor Coil). One more slot; Flight and Kinetic Shield need it.
steps.title: Blazing Frame

steps.text: Craft a Null Circuit: ender pearls and a nether star.
steps.title: Antigrav Age

steps.text: Mine Resonite Ore on the outer End islands. It alloys into Resonant Alloy.
steps.title: Echoes

steps.text: Get an Antigrav Core: Null Drill, Null Lance, Portal Projectors.
steps.title: Weightless

steps.text: Smith a Null Drill and dig a 12x12x12 cube in one swing.
steps.title: Big Holes

steps.text: Build the 7x3x7 Fusion Reactor, charge it with FE and add fusion fuel.
steps.title: Star in a Jar

steps.text: Put a Flight Module in an Exo chestplate and press K to fly.
steps.title: Lift Off

steps.text: Smith an Exo piece to Mk4 (Null Casing, Resonant Lattice). One more slot, fireproof.
steps.title: Null Frame

steps.text: Link two Portal Projectors with a Linking Card and step through the portal.
steps.title: Through the Lens

carry.name: Carry Upgrade
carry.rules: Right-click the terminal with it. It stays in for good.
carry.summary: Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up.

efficiency.name: Efficiency Upgrade
efficiency.rules: Never below 40% of the base cost.
efficiency.summary: Machines use 15% less FE per action per card.

fortune.name: Fortune Upgrade
fortune.rules: Not together with a Silk Touch card.
fortune.summary: Fortune I-III on mined blocks, more ore output, Looting in the Replicator.

growth.name: Growth Upgrade
growth.summary: Farm bots: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.

height.name: Height Upgrade
height.summary: Architect Table: buildings one block taller per card.

range.name: Range Upgrade
range.rules: What a step means depends on the machine.

silk.name: Silk Touch Upgrade
silk.rules: Single card. Not together with Fortune.

speed.name: Speed Upgrade
speed.rules: Each card is one step: x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20.
speed.summary: Machines work faster and use more FE per action.

void.name: Void Upgrade
void.summary: Deletes junk or outputs that don't fit.

effects.void: Extra outputs that don't fit are deleted instead of stalling.

effects.speed: FE/t x2, x3, x4; fuel burns faster still (more fuel per FE).
